resolution.question: Will the program officer at the Alder Foundation respond substantively to nonprofit director Lucia Ferreyra's unsolicited concept note within one month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the program officer at the Alder Foundation sent a substantive response (e.g., a reply with feedback, a request for more information, or an invitation to submit a full proposal) to Lucia Ferreyra before 2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
